bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,sys
db=[s for s in subprocess.check_output(['docker','ps','--format','{{.Names}}'],text=True).splitlines() if s.startswith('deploy-') and ('postgres' in s or s.endswith('-db-1'))]
assert len(db)==1
sql="""SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(t)),'[]'::json) FROM
 (SELECT chat_id,message_thread_id,message_id,state,pinned,(token_hash IS NOT NULL) has_token
 FROM topic_dm_entry_pins WHERE
 (chat_id=-1002373696859 AND message_thread_id=1605) OR
 (chat_id=-1003770334893 AND message_thread_id=4)) t;"""
out=subprocess.check_output(['docker','exec','-i',db[0],'sh','-lc','psql -X -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -A -t'],input=sql,text=True)
rows=json.loads(out)
for i,(chat,topic,path) in enumerate([(-1002373696859,1605,'/tmp/video_chat_1605_audit_20261124.json'),(-1003770334893,4,'/tmp/gay_chat_4_audit_20261124.json')]):
 matches=[r for r in rows if int(r['chat_id'])==chat and int(r['message_thread_id'])==topic]
 if len(matches)!=1:sys.exit(60+i)
 m=matches[0]
 d=json.loads(open(path).read().split('=',1)[1])['rows'][0]
 if m['state']!='published' or m['pinned'] is not True or not m['has_token']:sys.exit(62+i)
 if int(m['message_id']) not in [int(v) for v in d['history_message_ids']]:sys.exit(64+i)
 if 'normal' not in d['button_types']:sys.exit(66+i)
 if d['pin_state']!='ABSENT_FROM_PINS':sys.exit(68+i)
print('EXACT_EXISTING_BOT_ENTRY_REPIN_ELIGIBLE=2')
PY
